dimension_note: The fourth axis was added at slice 0.5 and is the reason the corpus was expanded: `naming` is whether the message names the CATEGORY the arm is filed under ('optimise the backend', 'adopt a framework') or the SYMPTOM the founder actually feels ('the turn is slow because it waits on X', 'this looks more solid but I don't know how much it ties us in'). Slice 0 measured 50% rank-1 and both misses were the two most symptom-phrased cases in the set, while every category-phrased case fired — so this is where failure was found, not where it was guessed. The second axis stays for the reason it was written: the same request about the same interface has two correct and opposite answers depending on it, and p10/p11 are the pair the census named as deciding whether this stays one door. Negative controls are drawn from the seven navigation skills that hold this trigger today, plus the adjacent doors of the suite, plus (n06/n07) the two doors a symptom-rich description is most likely to steal from.
coverage: 13 arms, 39 cases -- the band's ceiling. `doctor` is the 1.0.0 addition: p27 is the naked invocation (the menu, which must measure and never execute), p28 and p29 the symptom phrasings, p29 specifically the repository where no checker is installed. Three cases were retired to stay inside the band, and each was a BEHAVIOUR claim wearing a trigger case's clothes: p01 (explicit + category on `decide`, the easy shape every measured run already fired on), p30 (`decide` arriving with no measurement) and p31 (the bare-reseal rationalization). The last two are now checks c5 and c6, where a claim about what the run DOES belongs. `land` keeps its explicit work-packet case plus p32; its behaviour is additionally covered by the deterministic Decision landing fixtures.

fixtures_consumed.note: Symptom vocabulary for the 8 new cases was drawn from these real fixtures. A fixture used here as a TRIGGER case must not be reused as a slice-2 T3 BEHAVIOUR case: the trigger corpus would then be teaching the behaviour rubric its own answer. Fixture 6 was already spent as a behaviour case (bypass-test.md B3) and was deliberately NOT used here.
